description: Add ResourceHistoryPoint type, resourceHistory field to mission store, update updateFromSimResult to append snapshots, make endMission log param optional, expose resourceHistory in useMissionControl hook, and add V1 simplification comment to mission-scoring.ts. This is pure data-model work — no UI. Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: 1. In src/simulation/types/index.ts, add ResourceHistoryPoint interface after ResourceSnapshot: { readonly missionDay: number; readonly oxygen_kg: number; readonly water_kg: number; readonly food_kg: number; readonly energy_kWh: number; readonly cumulativeRadiation_mSv: number }

2. In src/store/mission-store.ts — (a) import ResourceHistoryPoint from @simulation/types; (b) add resourceHistory: readonly ResourceHistoryPoint[] to MissionState interface; (c) add resourceHistory: [] to INITIAL_MISSION_STATE; (d) change updateFromSimResult to use set((state) => ({ ... })) callback form and append to state.resourceHistory: [...state.resourceHistory, { missionDay: result.nextState.missionDay, ...result.nextState.resources }]; (e) make log param optional in MissionActions.endMission signature (log?: readonly DecisionLogEntry[]) and in the implementation default to [] with log ?? []

3. In src/hooks/useMissionControl.ts — (a) import ResourceHistoryPoint from @simulation/types; (b) add resourceHistory: readonly ResourceHistoryPoint[] to UseMissionControlReturn interface; (c) add const resourceHistory = useMissionStore((s) => s.resourceHistory) in hook body; (d) include resourceHistory in the return object

4. In src/simulation/core/mission-scoring.ts, add a JSDoc comment block above calculateMissionScore documenting two V1 simplifications: (1) eventsSuccessfullyResolved counts any RESOLVE_EVENT action where a matching choice was found, not specifically the optimal choice; (2) criticalFailureEvents counts POWER_CRITICAL fault triggers only — other critical faults (OXYGEN_DEPLETED, WATER_DEPLETED, RADIATION_CRITICAL) cause outcome=failure directly before scoring
acceptance_criteria: ResourceHistoryPoint interface exported from src/simulation/types/index.ts with all 6 readonly fields
Each history entry's missionDay and resource values match the SimulationResult.nextState passed in
endMission(score) with no log argument does not throw; decisionLog is set to []
useMissionControl() return type includes resourceHistory: readonly ResourceHistoryPoint[]
npm run build exits 0 — zero TypeScript errors
verification: npm run build — must exit 0 with zero TS and zero Vite errors
npm run test -- --run — all 75 baseline tests must still pass (no regressions from changing the store)
findings: ResourceHistoryPoint added to simulation types after ResourceSnapshot. resourceHistory field added to MissionState, INITIAL_MISSION_STATE, and the Zustand store. updateFromSimResult now uses set() callback form to append a new ResourceHistoryPoint entry on each step. endMission log param is now optional (defaults to []). useMissionControl hook exposes resourceHistory. V1 simplification JSDoc added to calculateMissionScore. All 75 baseline tests pass; build exits 0.
